content.concept_description: A player solves a sliding block puzzle by carefully shifting colored and checkerboard blocks to allow long color strips to exit the board.
content.why_it_works: The tactile Lego-style aesthetic and methodical puzzle-solving mechanics engage viewers who enjoy spatial reasoning and satisfying clearing actions.

visuals.primary_color: Slate Blue (#6e7c9c), Red (#eb3b3b), Green (#00c853), Yellow (#ffd600), Blue (#1e88e5)
visuals.notable_objects: Lego-style studs and puzzle tiles, pointer hand finger

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Sliding Lego-style colored border bars and checkerboard tiles to clear paths for each colored strip to exit through matching colored directional arrows.

chapterization.chapter_description: Initial setup displaying the challenge text 'I can't reach colors' as the hand attempts moves.
Manipulating black and white checkerboard blocks and sliding colored rails to open avenues.
Consecutively discharging the colored strips off the board into the collector exits.
